provider: ChatGPT consumer file storage / Library + Projects

free_tier.stated: 25 GB shared upload storage per user, 100 GB per organization. 512 MB per file. Project file counts: Free 5, Go/Plus 25, Edu/Pro/Business/Enterprise 40. GPT knowledge: 20 files. 'Users can create an unlimited amount of projects.'

egress.terms: Files can be previewed and downloaded from the project sources list; no egress fee.

interface_detail: Web/app UI. `GET /v1/files` with an API key does NOT expose ChatGPT Library files — the API and the consumer product are separate stores.
tooling: None programmatic for the consumer store.
chaining: Unlimited projects x 40 files x 512 MB = nominal 20 GB per project, but the 25 GB/user byte wall across all of it is the real cap. Nothing multiplies.

limits_note: per-object-cap 512 MB; CSV/spreadsheets ~50 MB; images 20 MB. Upload rate: 80 files per 3 hours; free users 3 uploads/day. Retention not stated as a limit — Library persists.
reliability_note: 25 GB/user is 20x below the brief's floor and the storage is explicitly 'shared upload storage' across the whole account, so projects do not stack. Notably better than the API for read-back ('open it from the project sources list to preview, download, or delete it') which is the inverse of the API's purpose-based read gate — but the byte wall makes it irrelevant.
